consts.name: dlxYearsSinceSplit
consts.comment: the years since the split - Tu Lung part of Shou Lung until a dispute over imperial succession 300 years ago (print capture p. 303)

consts.name: dlxProvinceCount
consts.comment: the province count - Tu Lung divided into six provinces (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxEarthDragon
bools.comment: the earth dragon - the empire name Tu Lung meaning Earth Dragon (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxPartOfShouLung
bools.comment: the part of Shou Lung - Tu Lung was part of Shou Lung until the succession dispute (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxOwnEmperorSeparateCourt
bools.comment: the own emperor separate court - claiming its own emperor, Tu Lung set up a separate imperial court (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxWarsStabilized
bools.comment: the wars stabilized - after many wars between the two states, the situation has stabilized (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxNoLoveLost
bools.comment: the no love lost - no love is lost between the two empires (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxRebelNoblesGreatPower
bools.comment: the rebel nobles great power - the Emperor of Tu Lung was supported by the powerful officials and nobles of the rebelling provinces, leading to their acquiring great power and strength (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxModeledAfterShouLung
bools.comment: the modeled after Shou Lung - although the government is modeled after that of Shou Lung (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxLuiDynasty
bools.comment: the Lui dynasty - the Emperor of Tu Lung of the Lui Dynasty (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxEmperorCannotBreakNobles
bools.comment: the emperor cannot break the nobles - the Emperor has never been able to break the power of his nobles (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxNoblesControlExaminations
bools.comment: the nobles control the examinations - the nobles control the examination system (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxOfficesHereditary
bools.comment: the offices hereditary - the nobles arranged for various offices to become hereditary (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxEstatesExemptEdicts
bools.comment: the estates exempt from edicts - the noble power allowed them to exempt their estates from most imperial edicts, including taxation (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxMajorityConsent
bools.comment: the majority consent - the Emperor can only enforce his edicts with the consent of the majority of the nobles (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxCommonersLittleChance
bools.comment: the commoners little chance - commoners have little chance to rise in the government (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxPostCorruption
bools.comment: the post corruption - corruption of official posts is common (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxHereditaryGovernors
bools.comment: the hereditary governors - each of the six provinces administered by a hereditary governor (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxDistrictsFamilyGraft
bools.comment: the districts family and graft - the provinces divided into districts, official positions assigned on the basis of family and graft (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxInheritedPublicWorks
bools.comment: the inherited public works - although Tu Lung inherited the public works of Shou Lung (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxWorksPoorlyMaintained
bools.comment: the works poorly maintained - the public works poorly maintained and new projects seldom undertaken (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxPeopleEasilyOppressed
bools.comment: the people easily oppressed - the people easily oppressed, having no recourse to the law (print capture p. 303)

bools.name: dlxCapitalPlotting
bools.comment: the capital plotting - the prime activity in the capital Chia Wan Chuan is political plotting (print capture p. 303 and p. 304)

bools.name: dlxSecretSocieties
bools.comment: the secret societies - many of the nobles of Tu Lung are leaders of secret societies pledged to overthrow the Emperor (print capture p. 304)
